# Cloud services agreement: data processing terms

Nimbusline Cloud India Private Limited serves Kadamba Fit Private Limited. Nimbusline Cloud Europe GmbH serves Kadamba Fit Ireland Limited. Signed 9 January 2025.

- Nimbusline hosts data only in the regions the customer selects and processes it only on the customer's documented instructions.
- Staff are bound to confidentiality. Sub-processors need 30 days' prior written notice and the same terms.
- Volumes and snapshots are encrypted at rest with customer-managed keys. Traffic between regions is encrypted.
- Nimbusline helps with data subject and Data Principal requests, security, DPIAs and breach reporting, and reports a personal data breach within 24 hours.
- Data is deleted within 30 days of the end of the service. The customer can audit on reasonable notice.

## Regions selected

| Cluster | Primary | Disaster recovery copy |
|---|---|---|
| India | ap-south-1 (Mumbai) | ap-southeast-1 (Singapore) |
| EU | eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) | eu-west-1 (Dublin) |
